test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Contact Us and search for flights

intents.intent: Click the 'Contact us' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Type $name into the 'Departure' input with placeholder 'Departure' on the 'Contact Us' page
Type $name into the 'Destination' input with placeholder 'Destination' on the 'Contact Us' page
Click the 'Search' button on the 'Contact Us' page
And then check that the search results are displayed according to the entered departure and destination

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Contact Us and apply a promo code

intents.intent: Click the 'Contact us' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click the 'Apply promo code' button on the 'Contact Us' page
And then check that the promo code input or confirmation is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate from Privacy Policy to Contact Us and switch trip type to One way

intents.intent: Click the 'Contact us' link on the 'Privacy Policy' page
Click the 'One way' radio button on the 'Contact Us' page
And then check that the trip type is set to 'One way'
